metadata.title: Travel Smarter This Puja: Verified Alerts & Advisory
metadata.authority: Kolkata Police Traffic Department & WB Transport Corporation

traffic_alerts.title: Rashbehari Avenue Pedestrian Corridor
traffic_alerts.location: Rashbehari Avenue (between Gariahat Crossing & Chetla Bridge)
traffic_alerts.timing: Daily from 4:00 PM to 4:00 AM (Sasthi to Dashami)
traffic_alerts.detail: No private cars or four-wheelers permitted. Dedicated pedestrian pathways established. Emergency vehicles exempt.

traffic_alerts.title: Chittaranjan (C.R.) Avenue Flow Adjustment
traffic_alerts.location: C.R. Avenue from MG Road to Girish Park
traffic_alerts.detail: One-way northward flow for commercial and transport buses. Southward traffic diverted via Bidhan Sarani and Amherst Street.

traffic_alerts.title: VIP Road Sreebhumi Service Lane Restriction
traffic_alerts.location: VIP Road at Lake Town & Sreebhumi Entry
traffic_alerts.detail: Main VIP Road flyovers open for airport commuters. Service roads strictly pedestrianized. Airport travelers must use the main flyover to avoid 90+ min gridlocks.

traffic_alerts.title: Bagbazar Street & Rabindra Sarani Corridor
traffic_alerts.location: Bagbazar Street between Shyambazar 5-Point & Bagbazar Ghat
traffic_alerts.detail: Closed for heavy motorized transport. Tram lines barricaded for organized queue management into Bagbazar Sarbojanin.

crowd_advisories.recommended_window: 07:00 AM - 11:30 AM (Morning) or 02:00 AM - 05:00 AM (Late Night)
crowd_advisories.advisory: Pandals like Bagbazar and Sovabazar Rajbari are peaceful during early morning puja offering hours. Use Shyambazar or Sovabazar metro.
Santosh Mitra Square and College Square experience extreme human density. Avoid carrying bulky backpacks. Expect serpentine barricaded queues.
Ekdalia Evergreen and Singhi Park queues converge at Gariahat. Visitors are advised to alight at Kalighat Metro and walk via Southern Avenue.

alternative_pandals.reason: Rich heritage artwork, tranquil open park environment, and zero crushing vehicular gridlock compared to VIP Road.
Authentic freedom movement history and magnificent classical idols within 10 minutes walking radius without 3-hour barricades.
Lakeside serenity along Southern Avenue with world-class artistic theme architecture and spacious walking paths.
